verdict.rationale: Pandoc ships a Haskell library alongside the CLI (pandoc-docs-17) and an HTTP server mode available via `pandoc-server` (pandoc-docs-30). Its Lua filter, custom reader and writer interfaces offer further programmatic hooks (pandoc-docs-15, pandoc-docs-16), and its CLI is thoroughly documented and stdin/stdout-friendly (pandoc-docs-5, pandoc-probe-4). However, the evidence only mentions the library and server mode in passing and does not show their API documentation, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented API reference for the library or server endpoints, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), independent or hands-on corroboration of driving it via the API.
